race.comment: LOLLIE'S GALORE (2) has been solid in two runs back from a spell, working home well for fourth at Pakenham Synthetic last time in a decent maiden. Fitter again third up and the rise to 1615m will suit this son of The Autumn Sun ideally, go close. HAKUSAN (11) went from 1400m to 1717m second up here and stuck on well enough. Should be at peak fitness now and suspect they'll try to run along from the inside. RANG A ROUND UP (5) resumes off a long break. That's the issue but he was showing some promise last time in and this is a suitable trip to kick off in. Watch betting. GOLDEN THOUGHTS (1) is a well-bred gelding by So You Think for the Griffiths yard. He draws well and watch the market. OBSIDIAN STONE (13) struggled in a strong maiden on debut but could improve sharply given he was kept safe in betting there.
